observation: The original Kernel text labels mode 2 Battle. Its resident entry is 0x8001b6c4; the dispatcher uses directory (0,1) and resource number 16, selecting source slot 38 on Disc 1 and 33 on Disc 2. Both packed projections contain 166564 bytes and independently decode to identical 343936-byte resources. The resident path calls the original overlay at 0x80070f40. Its first 128 bytes match the preserved Disc 1 reset-default attempt. That bounded attempt ends in a uniform teal image, without a visible playable battle.
interpretation: This gives both discs an original-source battle-family inventory entry and preserves the unsuccessful launch as a research gap. It does not catalogue formations, enemies, arenas, on-foot/Gear distinctions or battle behavior. The source family is one shared code identity, not two battles.

preconditions: Both full-hash original raw-track profiles and independent source projections
Original source decoder instructions and directory/dispatcher evidence from EVID-REF-007
Preserved bounded cold-boot Battle input attempt from EVID-REF-009
commands: Read original boot labels at 0x800182f8, mode entry at 0x8001808c+2*16, resource number at 0x8004eaa0+2*4 and directory halfword 1 at logical LBA 40. Follow the stated original dispatcher/source helpers to compute slot = directory_halfword_1 + 16 - 2.

Read and hash complete original source entries at the recorded slots. Decode complete measured source sectors using the independently transcribed original 0x80032eb4 routine; compare the 128-byte window at decoded offset 0x1450 with preserved Disc 1 RAM at 0x70f40.

Reproduce the kernel-cross-battle-probe case in tests/reference-inputs/kernel-mode-observation-route.json using the documented scenario CLI and a fresh private directory; inspect the final image. Input-program completion is not battle readiness.
validation.expected: Exact source identity and original dispatch attribution, with the reset-default unsuccessful output retained and no gameplay pass.
validation.actual: Both complete raw-track hashes and boot identities passed. Source-slot arithmetic, packed/decoded identities, five resident windows and the overlay window matched. The final Disc 1 image was independently viewed as flat teal; no battle launch or combat claim is made.
validation.tolerance: Exact bytes and hashes for source attribution; only the observed unsuccessful target output is asserted. No deterministic gameplay, formation setup or native implementation.
